note: Starts as a copy of sim.json. Follow mode refuses to run on the robot until every section below has a 'measured' entry; measure each with the tool named in its 'how' field (gpt_astra/ROBOT_FOLLOW_CHECKLIST.md).

camera.how: python -m gpt_astra.tools.check_camera --write gpt_astra/calibration/robot.json (balloon at taped spots, robot standing still or in the gantry)
camera.rotation_note: columns: camera x (image right), y (image up), z (backwards) in the pelvis frame

balloon.how: same check_camera session: the balloon's real diameter, red thresholds under the lab lights, no detections without the balloon or on red clothing

grab.how: run.py --grab-check in the gantry with tools/record_lowstate.py, then tools/grab_report.py --write

walk.how: run.py --walk-check on the floor (gantry slack) with a balloon on a stand, then tools/walk_report.py --write; the speeds must equal the robot build's WALK_SPEED/FINE_WALK_SPEED

safety.note: Chosen limits, not measurements. Dead reckoning uses the commanded speeds (an upper bound on distance). lost_walk_s: keep walking only this long after the balloon was last seen (a few camera frames).
